answer: Pay agents through a correlation filter: each epoch, rewards flow like a river past a jetty that measures how similar every agent's outputs, timing and errors are. Identities whose fingerprints cluster share one payout, split N ways, while each still posts its own entry stake. A farm of N clones thus pays N stakes for one reward, and its loss grows with every clone added. Only a genuinely distinct mind, rare as carved jade, earns a full share.
